capabilities: Search entries by prefix, fuzzy, or full-text
Insert definitions as callouts, footnotes, or wikilinks
extras: Fully offline with zero telemetry and works in air-gapped environments; includes one-click download of sample dictionaries. Fuzzy search uses CJK bigram intersection. README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
problem: Obsidian freezes for 20–40 seconds when opening large (20MB–100MB+) Markdown files, and it has no fast way to use Markdown notes as lookup dictionaries.
summary: Dictionary reader and lookup engine that turns plain Markdown files into fast, offline dictionaries with prefix, fuzzy, and full-text search.
